I wrote `component.html` in the folder. It's a 1280×800 empty state screen inside `#component`, using only static HTML and CSS. I haven't opened it in a browser, so I haven't seen how it renders.

- **Content:** all of your copy appears exactly as given. That's the "Requests" heading, the "No requests yet" title and line, the "Create a Request" button and the "Import from a spreadsheet" link. I also added a small "Harbor" wordmark in a top bar, which wasn't in your content list. Delete it if you want the content strictly limited to your list.
- **Design system:**
  - The colors, type sizes, letter-spacing values, 4px spacing, radii and motion timings all come from `DESIGN.md`.
  - The "Requests" heading is Unbounded Light in all caps. The title is Unbounded Medium at 28px.
  - The button is an ink pill. The link is accent blue.
  - The panel has a dashed accent border and a decorative inbox icon.
- **Fonts:** the folder has no font files and the task rules out outside assets, so Unbounded and Archivo aren't loaded. The CSS names them first and falls back to Helvetica Neue or Arial. They will only render if installed locally.
